conditional_argument_review.status: Valid as a narrow per-effect argument under the stated store contract.
conditional_argument_review.reason: BEGIN IMMEDIATE serializes receipt lookup, exact-body validation, current-version check, mutation, version increment, effect journal and successful receipt insert. An exact successful replay returns without mutation; an unseen operation with an older expected version is rejected. Monotonic tombstones prevent value ABA from erasing version history.
conditional_argument_review.required_assumptions: Receipts and effect share one transaction; identity and full arguments remain fixed for replay; all accepted writes advance one durable monotonic version; receipt/version history is retained; reads/writes use this store interface.
conditional_argument_review.boundaries_preserved: This is neither a new theorem/protocol nor proof of whole-plan atomicity, safe reclamation, arbitrary concurrency or correctness of the primary two-store receipt scheme. Historical acknowledgement is correctly distinguished from keeping an old desired value current.
conditional_argument_review.formula: For the declared single-valued target, x!=y prevents simultaneous old-intent content equality and preservation of a later accepted y absent a newer accepted update. This is a scoped logical incompatibility, not a distributed impossibility result.
conditional_argument_review.identity_binding_boundary: Only a successful retained receipt binds identity to arguments; rejected comparison attempts do not bind it. The final wording and inspected boundary test now state this explicitly.

native_fairness_review.interpretation: Equality supports bounded portability and is not framed as superiority or optimal framework usage.

journal_research_gap_separate_from_corre: The primitives and broad fault/conformance method have strong direct antecedents. A synthetic factorial and an adapter counterexample do not automatically establish a generalizable leading-journal advance.

The24calls are a single-alias/single-harness pilot with no semantic adjudication or natural workload distribution. The36recorded-plan integrations reuse those outputs and are not more independent model samples.

The native implementation shares controlled fixtures/planner and application semantics. More independent memory implementations and contract/workload changes would be needed to demonstrate transfer beyond this authored setup.
Bounded sequential schedules and one race per process cell do not cover arbitrary interleavings, remote consistency, mid-commit failure, retention reclamation or transient-reader isolation.

Outside replication, stronger independently specified oracles and a clearly useful new conditional insight remain research opportunities. Listing these gaps is not evidence they have been solved, and no acceptance-readiness conclusion is made.
overall_conclusion: The rewritten manuscript is materially more precise and its central finite claims match retained evidence. It honestly attributes established mechanisms and limits exploratory extensions. No numerical or core citation-scope correction remains mandatory in this reviewed version; journal novelty and external validity remain open research questions.
